title: 第一回     靈根育孕源流出　心性修持大道生

paragraphs.en: 詩曰： 混沌未分天地亂，茫茫渺渺無人見。 自從盤古破鴻濛，開闢從茲清濁辨。 覆載群生仰至仁，發明萬物皆成善。 欲知造化會元功，須看西遊釋厄傳。
paragraphs.zh:
Poem:  
Before the chaos was divided, the heavens and the earth were in disorder,  
Vast and boundless, no one could see.  
Since Pangu split the primordial chaos,  
From then on, the clear and the turbid were distinguished.  
The heaven and earth nurture all living beings, relying on ultimate benevolence,  
The creation of all things has become good.  
If you wish to know the profound merits of the universe,  
You must read "Journey to the West: The Story of Alleviating Calamities."

paragraphs.en: 蓋聞天地之數，有十二萬九千六百歲為一元。將一元分為十二會，乃子、丑、寅 、卯、辰、巳、午、未、申、酉、戌、亥之十二支也。每會該一萬八百歲。且就 一日而論：子時得陽氣，而丑則雞鳴﹔寅不通光，而卯則日出﹔辰時食後，而巳 則挨排﹔日午天中，而未則西蹉﹔申時晡，而日落酉，戌黃昏，而人定亥。譬於 大數，若到戌會之終，則天地昏曚而萬物否矣。再去五千四百歲，交亥會之初， 則當黑暗，而兩間人物俱無矣，故曰混沌。又五千四百歲，亥會將終，貞下起元 ，近子之會，而復逐漸開明。邵康節曰：：「冬至子之半，天心無改移。一陽初 動處，萬物未生時。」到此，天始有根。再五千四百歲，正當子會，輕清上騰， 有日，有月，有星，有辰。日、月、星、辰，謂之四象。故曰，天開於子。又經 五千四百歲，子會將終，近丑之會，而逐漸堅實。《易》曰：「大哉乾元！至哉 坤元！萬物資生，乃順承天。」至此，地始凝結。再五千四百歲，正當丑會，重 濁下凝，有水，有火，有山，有石，有土。水、火、山、石、土，謂之五形。故 曰，地闢於丑。又經五千四百歲，丑會終而寅會之初，發生萬物。曆曰：「天氣 下降，地氣上升﹔天地交合，群物皆生。」至此，天清地爽，陰陽交合。再五千 四百歲，子會將終，近丑之會，而逐漸堅實。《易》曰：「大哉乾元！至哉坤元 ！萬物資生，乃順承天。」至此，地始凝結。再五千四百歲，正當丑會，重濁下 凝，有水，有火，有山，有石，有土。水、火、山、石、土，謂之五形。故曰， 地闢於丑。又經五千四百歲，丑會終而寅會之初，發生萬物。曆曰：「天氣下降 ，地氣上升﹔天地交合，群物皆生。」至此，天清地爽，陰陽交合。再五千四百 歲，正當寅會，生人，生獸，生禽，正謂天地人，三才定位。故曰，人生於寅。
paragraphs.zh: It is said that the number of heaven and earth is twelve thousand nine hundred and sixty years for one yuan. Dividing one yuan into twelve periods, they are the twelve branches: rat, ox, tiger, rabbit, dragon, snake, horse, goat, monkey, rooster, dog, and boar. Each period lasts eighteen hundred years. Taking one day as an example: the rat hour brings in the yang energy, while the ox hour is when the rooster crows; the tiger hour is still dark, but the rabbit hour is when the sun rises; the dragon hour is after breakfast, and the snake hour is when things are arranged; the horse hour is noon, and the goat hour is when the sun begins to set; the monkey hour is the afternoon, and the sun sets in the rooster hour; the dog hour is dusk, and the boar hour is when people are settled. If we take this great cycle into account, when the dog period ends, the world becomes dim and all things are in a state of disorder. After another five thousand four hundred years, when the boar period begins, it is a time of darkness, and there are no beings in the universe, hence called the chaos. Another five thousand four hundred years later, when the boar period is about to end, the beginning of the yuan starts again, approaching the rat period, and gradually becomes clear. Shao Kangjie said: "At the middle of winter solstice, the heart of heaven remains unchanged. When the first yang begins to move, all things have not yet been born." At this time, heaven begins to have a root. Another five thousand four hundred years later, during the rat period, the light and clear elements rise upward, and there are the sun, the moon, the stars, and the constellations. The sun, moon, stars, and constellations are called the four images. Hence, it is said that heaven was opened in the rat period. After another five thousand four hundred years, when the rat period is about to end, approaching the ox period, things gradually become solid. The Book of Changes says: "Great is the primordial force of heaven! Supreme is the primordial force of earth! All things derive their existence, and thus follow the heaven." At this time, the earth begins to solidify. Another five thousand four hundred years later, during the ox period, the heavy and turbid elements sink and condense, and there are water, fire, mountains, stones, and earth. Water, fire, mountains, stones, and earth are called the five elements. Hence, it is said that the earth was opened in the ox period. After another five thousand four hundred years, when the ox period ends and the tiger period begins, all things begin to arise. The calendar says: "The heavenly energy descends, and the earthly energy ascends; the heaven and earth combine, and all things are born." At this time, the heaven is clear and the earth is fresh, and the yin and yang combine. Another five thousand four hundred years later, when the rat period is about to end, approaching the ox period, things gradually become solid. The Book of Changes says: "Great is the primordial force of heaven! Supreme is the primordial force of earth! All things derive their existence, and thus follow the heaven." At this time, the earth begins to solidify. Another five thousand four hundred years later, during the ox period, the heavy and turbid elements sink... Ning, has water, fire, mountain, stone, and earth. Water, fire, mountain, stone, and earth are called the Five Forms. Therefore, it is said, "The earth was opened in the period of Chou." After another 5,400 years, when the Chou period ends and the Yin period begins, all things come into being. The calendar says: "The heavenly qi descends, the earthly qi ascends; the union of heaven and earth gives birth to all creatures." At this point, the sky is clear and the earth is fresh, and the yin and yang are united. After another 5,400 years, during the Yin period, human beings, beasts, and birds are born. This is precisely the establishment of the Three Realms: Heaven, Earth, and Humanity. Therefore, it is said, "Human beings are born in the Yin period."

paragraphs.en: 感盤古開闢，三皇治世，五帝定倫，世界之間，遂分為四大部洲：曰東勝神洲， 曰西牛賀洲，曰南贍部洲，曰北俱蘆洲。這部書單表東勝神洲。海外有一國土， 名曰傲來國。國近大海，海中有一座名山，喚為花果山。此山乃十洲之祖脈，三 島之來龍，自開清濁而立，鴻濛判後而成。真個好山！有詞賦為證。賦曰：勢鎮 汪洋，威寧瑤海。勢鎮汪洋，潮湧銀山魚入穴﹔威寧瑤海，波翻雪浪蜃離淵。水 火方隅高積上，東海之處聳崇巔。丹崖怪石，削壁奇峰。丹崖上，彩鳳雙鳴﹔削 壁前，麒麟獨臥。峰頭時聽錦雞鳴，石窟每觀龍出入。林中有壽鹿仙狐，樹上有 靈禽玄鶴。瑤草奇花不謝，青松翠柏長春。仙桃常結果，修竹每留雲。一條澗壑 籐蘿密，四面原堤草色新。正是百川會處擎天柱，萬劫無移大地根。
paragraphs.zh:
It is said that Pangu opened up the universe, the Three Sovereigns governed the world, and the Five Emperors established the order of human relationships. Thus, the world was divided into four great continents: the East Shengzhou, the West Niuhezhou, the South Zhanbuzhou, and the North Juluzhou. This book only describes the East Shengzhou. Beyond the sea there is a country called Aolai. This country is near the sea, and in the sea there is a famous mountain called Huaguo. This mountain is the ancestral source of the ten states and the origin of the three islands. It was formed since the separation of the clear and the turbid, and it was established after the division of the primordial chaos. Indeed, it is a very good mountain! There is a poem to prove it. The poem says: 

Its power controls the vast ocean, its might dominates the jade sea. 
Its power controls the vast ocean, the tides surge like silver mountains, and fish enter the caves; 
Its might dominates the jade sea, the waves roll like snow, and the sea monsters leave their depths. 
In the corners of fire and water, high peaks are piled up, and in the east sea, towering peaks rise. 
Red cliffs with strange rocks, steep cliffs with extraordinary peaks. 
On the red cliffs, two colorful phoenixes sing; before the steep cliffs, a qilin lies alone. 
On the peak, the sound of a golden rooster is heard; in the stone caves, dragons are seen entering and exiting. 
In the forest, there are immortal deer and foxes; on the trees, there are spiritual birds and black cranes. 
The jade grass and strange flowers never wither; the cypresses and pines are evergreen. 
The immortal peaches often bear fruit, and the tall bamboos always keep the clouds. 
A stream is covered with vines and creepers, and the four sides of the flat land are covered with fresh green grass. 
Indeed, it is the pillar that supports the sky where all the rivers meet, and the unshakable root of the earth through countless eons.

paragraphs.en: 那座山正當頂上，有一塊仙石。其石有三丈六尺五寸高，有二丈四尺圍圓。三丈 六尺五寸高，按周天三百六十五度﹔二丈四尺圍圓，按政曆二十四氣。上有九竅 八孔，按九宮八卦。四面更無樹木遮陰，左右倒有芝蘭相襯。
paragraphs.zh: At the very top of the mountain stood a divine stone. This stone was 3 zhang, 6 chi, and 5 cun in height, and 2 zhang and 4 chi in circumference. The height of 3 zhang, 6 chi, and 5 cun corresponds to the 365 degrees of the celestial sphere; the circumference of 2 zhang and 4 chi corresponds to the 24 solar terms of the calendar. It had nine apertures and eight holes, corresponding to the nine palaces and the eight trigrams. There were no trees shading it on any of the four sides, but on either side there were orchids and ferns complementing it.

paragraphs.en: 蓋自開闢以來，每受天真地秀，日精月華，感之既久，遂有靈通之意。內育仙胞 ，一日迸裂，產一石卵，似圓毬樣大。因見風，化作一個石猴，五官俱備，四肢 皆全。便就學爬學走，拜了四方。目運兩道金光，射沖斗府。驚動高天上聖大慈 仁者玉皇大天尊玄穹高上帝，駕座金闕雲宮靈霄寶殿，聚集仙卿，見有金光燄燄 ，即命千里眼、順風耳開南天門觀看。二將果奉旨出門外，看的真，聽的明。須 臾回報道：「臣奉旨觀聽金光之處，乃東勝神洲海東傲來小國之界，有一座花果 山，山上有一仙石，石產一卵，見風化一石猴，在那裏拜四方，眼運金光，射沖 斗府。如今服餌水食，金光將潛息矣。」玉帝垂賜恩慈曰：「下方之物，乃天地 精華所生，不足為異。」
paragraphs.zh: Since the beginning of the world, it has always received the essence of heaven and earth, the radiance of the sun and the brilliance of the moon. After being influenced for a long time, it gradually gained the ability of spiritual awareness. Inside, it nurtured a divine embryo. One day, it burst open and produced a stone egg, as round as a ball. Due to the wind, it transformed into a stone monkey, with all five organs and four limbs complete. It then learned to crawl and walk, and paid respects to all four directions. Its eyes emitted two beams of golden light, shooting up to the heavenly palace of the constellations. This alarmed the Supreme Heavenly Sage, the Merciful and Benevolent Lord, the Jade Emperor, the Great Celestial, the Supreme Lord of the Profound Heaven. He was seated on the golden palace of the cloud palace, the Lingxiao Hall, gathering the immortals. Upon seeing the bright golden light, he immediately ordered the Thousand-Mile Eye and the Wind-Listening Ear to open the Southern Heaven Gate and look. The two generals obeyed the order and went outside, seeing clearly and hearing distinctly. Soon they returned and reported: "We, following your order, observed the place where the golden light appeared. It is in the East Sheng Shen Zhou, in the eastern sea of the small country of Ao Lai, there is a Hua Guo Mountain. On the mountain there is a divine stone, which produced an egg. Upon encountering the wind, it became a stone monkey, which is now paying respects to all four directions. Its eyes emit golden light, which shoots up to the heavenly palace of the constellations. Now, it is eating and drinking water, and the golden light will soon disappear." The Jade Emperor kindly said, "The thing below is born from the essence of heaven and earth, and there is no need to be surprised."

paragraphs.en: 那猴在山中，卻會行走跳躍，食草木，飲澗泉，採山花，覓樹果﹔與狼蟲為伴， 虎豹為群，獐鹿為友，獼猿為親﹔夜宿石崖之下，朝遊峰洞之中。真是：「山中 無甲子，寒盡不知年。」 一朝天氣炎熱，與群猴避暑，都在松陰之下頑耍。你看他一個個： 跳樹攀枝，採花覓果﹔拋彈子，?麼兒﹔跑沙窩，砌寶塔﹔趕蜻蜓，撲蜡﹔參老 天，拜菩薩﹔扯葛籐，編草﹔捉虱子，咬又掐﹔理毛衣，剔指甲。挨的挨，擦的 擦﹔推的推，壓的壓﹔扯的扯，拉的拉：青松林下任他頑，綠水澗邊隨洗濯。
paragraphs.zh:
That monkey, in the mountain, could walk and leap about, eat grass and trees, drink from mountain springs, pick wild flowers, and search for fruits on trees. It was companions with wolves and serpents, grouped with tigers and leopards, friends with roe deer and stags, and intimate with macaques. At night, it would sleep under stone cliffs, and in the morning, it would roam through mountain caves. Truly, it was said: "In the mountain, there are no years; the cold ends, but one does not know the year."

One day, when the weather was hot, the monkey and the other monkeys sought shade, playing around under the pine trees. Look at them: jumping from tree to branch, picking flowers, searching for fruits; throwing pebbles, playing with little toys; digging in the sand, building towers of sand; chasing dragonflies, catching moths; paying homage to the Elder Heaven, worshipping the Bodhisattva; pulling vines, weaving grass; catching lice, biting and scratching; grooming their fur, trimming their nails. Some were pushing, some were pressing; some were pulling, some were dragging. Under the green pines, they played freely; by the green water stream, they washed themselves as they pleased.

paragraphs.en: 一群猴子耍了一會，卻去那山澗中洗澡。見那股澗水奔流，真個似滾瓜湧濺。古 云：「禽有禽言，獸有獸語。」眾猴都道：「這股水不知是那裏的水。我們今日 趕閑無事，順澗邊往上溜頭尋看源流，耍子去耶！」喊一聲，都拖男挈女，呼弟 呼兄，一齊跑來，順澗爬山，直至源流之處，乃是一股瀑布飛泉。但見那： 一派白虹起，千尋雪浪飛。 海風吹不斷，江月照還依。 冷氣分青嶂，餘流潤翠微。 潺湲名瀑布，真似掛簾帷。
paragraphs.zh:
A group of monkeys played for a while, then went to bathe in the mountain stream. Seeing the stream rushing and flowing, it was indeed like a rolling gourd splashing about. As an ancient saying goes: "Birds have their own language, and beasts have their own speech." The monkeys all said, "This water is from where? Since we have nothing to do today, let's follow the stream upstream, and see where it comes from, for our own amusement!" With a shout, they all took their children, called their brothers and sisters, and ran together, climbing up the stream and the mountain until they reached the source, which was a waterfall pouring down from above. It was seen as: 

A white dragon rising, thousands of feet of snow-like waves flying.  
The sea wind cannot stop it, the river moon shines upon it still.  
Cold air separates the green hills, remaining streams moisten the greenery.  
The murmuring name of the waterfall, truly like a hanging curtain.

paragraphs.en: 眾猴拍手稱揚道：「好水，好水！原來此處遠通山腳之下，直接大海之波。」又 道：「那一個有本事的，鑽進去尋個源頭出來，不傷身體者，我等即拜他為王。」 連呼了三聲，忽見叢雜中跳出一個石猴，應聲高叫道：「我進去，我進去。」好 猴！也是他： 今日芳名顯，時來大運通。 有緣居此地，王遣入仙宮。
paragraphs.zh: All the monkeys clapped and praised, "Good water, good water! It turns out this place extends far down to the foot of the mountain, directly connecting to the ocean's waves." They also said, "Whoever has the ability to dive in and find the source, and come out without getting hurt, we will all bow to him as our king." They called three times, and suddenly a stone monkey jumped out from among the crowd, and shouted in response, "I'll go in, I'll go in." What a remarkable monkey! It was also him: Today his name is revealed, when the time comes, his fortune is broad. With the right connection, he is sent into the immortal palace.

paragraphs.en: 你看他瞑目蹲身，將身一縱，徑跳入瀑布泉中，忽睜睛抬頭觀看，那裏邊卻無水 無波，明明朗朗的一架橋梁。他住了身，定了神，仔細再看，原來是座鐵板橋。 橋下之水，沖貫於石竅之間，倒掛流出去，遮閉了橋門。卻又欠身上橋頭，再走 再看，卻似有人家住處一般，真個好所在。但見那：
paragraphs.zh: You saw him closing his eyes, crouching down, and leaping with a single bound into the waterfall. Suddenly, he opened his eyes and looked up. Inside, there was no water, no ripples; clearly and brightly, there was a bridge. He stopped, steadied his spirit, and looked more carefully. It was actually an iron bridge. The water beneath the bridge rushed through the stone holes, flowed downward, and blocked the entrance to the bridge. Then he climbed up to the top of the bridge and walked again, looking around. It seemed as if there were people living there. Indeed, it was a very good place. It was like this:

paragraphs.en: 翠蘚堆藍，白雲浮玉，光搖片片煙霞。虛窗靜室，滑凳板生花。乳窟龍珠倚掛， 縈迴滿地奇葩。鍋灶傍崖存火跡，樽罍靠案見殽渣。石座石床真可愛，石盆石碗 更堪誇。又見那一竿兩竿修竹，三點五點梅花。幾樹青松常帶雨，渾然像個人家。
paragraphs.zh: Crimson moss piles up like blue, white clouds float like jade, light shines upon fragments of mist and rosy clouds. The empty window and quiet room, the smooth bench is covered with flowers. In the cave of milk, dragon pearls hang, and flowers spread all over the ground. The stove and cooking area by the cliff still show traces of fire, and the wine vessels by the table reveal remnants of food. Stone seats and stone beds are truly lovely, stone basins and stone bowls are even more admirable. Again, there are one or two bamboo poles, three or five plum blossoms. Several green pines are always covered with rain, looking just like a human dwelling.

paragraphs.en: 看罷多時，跳過橋中間，左右觀看。只見正當中有一石碣，碣上有一行楷書大字 ，鐫著「花果山福地，水簾洞洞天」。
paragraphs.zh: After looking for a long time, he jumped over the middle of the bridge and looked around left and right. He saw in the center a stone tablet, on which there was a line of regular script characters, engraved as "The Happy Land of Huaguo Mountain, the Celestial Grotto of the Waterfall Cave."

paragraphs.en: 石猿喜不自勝，急抽身往外便走，復瞑目蹲身，跳出水外，打了兩個呵呵道： 「大造化！大造化！」眾猴把他圍住，問道：「裏面怎麼樣？水有多深？」石猴 道：「沒水！沒水！原來是一座鐵板橋，橋那邊是一座天造地設的家當。」眾猴 道：「怎見得是個家當？」石猴笑道：「這股水乃是橋下沖貫石橋，倒掛下來遮 閉門戶的。橋邊有花有樹，乃是一座石房。房內有石窩、石灶、石碗、石盆、石 床、石凳。中間一塊石碣上，鐫著『花果山福地，水簾洞洞天』。真個是我們安 身之處。裏面且是寬闊，容得千百口老小。 我們都進去住，也省得受老天之氣。這裏邊： 刮風有處躲，下雨好存身。 霜雪全無懼，雷聲永不聞。 煙霞常照耀，祥瑞每蒸熏。 松竹年年秀，奇花日日新。」
paragraphs.zh: The stone monkey was overjoyed and could hardly contain himself. He quickly turned and rushed out, then closed his eyes, crouched down, and leaped out of the water, laughing twice and saying, "Great fortune! Great fortune!" The other monkeys surrounded him and asked, "What's inside? How deep is the water?" The stone monkey said, "No water! No water! It's actually an iron bridge. On the other side is a naturally created dwelling." The monkeys asked, "How do you know it's a dwelling?" The stone monkey laughed and said, "This stream flows through the stone bridge below and hangs down to block the entrance. By the bridge there are flowers and trees, forming a stone house. Inside there are stone basins, stone stoves, stone bowls, stone basins, stone beds, and stone benches. In the middle, a stone tablet is engraved with 'The Happy Land of Hua Guo Mountain, the Cave of the Waterfall's Heaven.' Indeed, this is our place to settle down. It's spacious enough to accommodate hundreds of families. We can all go in and live there, thus avoiding the wrath of the heavens. Here: When it's windy, there's a place to hide; when it rains, there's a place to stay. No fear of frost or snow, no sound of thunder. Mist and clouds constantly shine upon it, and auspicious spirits always warm it. Pines and bamboo are always green, and rare flowers are ever fresh."

paragraphs.en: 眾猴聽得，個個歡喜。都道：「你還先走，帶我們進去，進去。」石猴卻又瞑目 蹲身，往裏一跳，叫道：「都隨我進來，進來。」那些猴有膽大的，都跳進去了 ﹔膽小的，一個個伸頭縮頸，抓耳撓腮，大聲叫喊，纏一會，也都進去了。跳過 橋頭，一個個搶盆奪碗，佔灶爭床，搬過來，移過去，正是猴性頑劣，再無一個 寧時，只搬得力倦神疲方止。石猿端坐上面道：「列位呵，『人而無信，不知其 可。』你們才說有本事進得來，出得去，不傷身體者，就拜他為王。我如今進來 又出去，出去又進來，尋了這一個洞天與列位安眠穩睡，各享成家之福，何不拜 我為王？」眾猴聽說，即拱伏無違，一個個序齒排班，朝上禮拜，都稱「千歲大 王」。自此，石猿高登王位，將「石」字兒隱了，遂稱「美猴王」。有詩為證。 詩曰： 三陽交泰產群生，仙石胞含日月精。 借卵化猴完大道，假他名姓配丹成。 內觀不識因無相，外合明知作有形。 歷代人人皆屬此，稱王稱聖任縱橫。
paragraphs.zh:
All the monkeys heard this and were all very happy. They said, "You go first, lead us in, in!" But the stone monkey again closed his eyes and crouched down, jumping into the cave and calling out, "Follow me in, in!" Some of the monkeys, who were brave, jumped in; those who were timid, one by one, stuck out their heads and pulled them back, scratched their ears and rubbed their cheeks, shouting loudly. After some time, they also jumped in. Crossing the bridge, they grabbed basins and bowls, fought over stoves and beds, moving things back and forth. It was just the mischievous nature of monkeys, and there was no moment of peace. They kept moving until they were exhausted and tired. The stone ape sat up and said, "My friends, 'A person without trust is not worth knowing.' You all said that whoever could enter and exit without harming his body would be our king. Now I have gone in and out, gone out and in again, and found this cave for you all to sleep and rest, each enjoying the happiness of a family. Why don't you all pay homage to me as your king?" The monkeys, upon hearing this, immediately bowed and submitted without any resistance. One by one, they lined up according to age, paid homage to the top, and all called him "Ten Thousand Years, Great King." From that day on, the stone ape ascended the throne, concealed the character "stone," and was hence called "the Monkey King." There is a poem to confirm this:

Three yangs meet and produce all living beings, the divine stone egg contains the essence of the sun and moon.  
Using an egg to transform into a monkey to complete the great path, borrowing a name to match the elixir.  
Internally observing, one does not recognize due to no form; externally, one knows clearly to make it tangible.  
Throughout history, all people belong to this, being king or sage, freely moving about.

paragraphs.en: 美猴王領一群猿猴、獼猴、馬猴等，分派了君臣佐使。朝遊花果山，暮宿水簾洞 ，合契同情，不入飛鳥之叢，不從走獸之類，獨自為王，不勝歡樂。是以： 春採百花為飲食，夏尋諸果作生涯。 秋收芋栗延時節，冬覓黃精度歲華。
paragraphs.zh: The Beauty Monkey King led a group of apes, macaques, and horse monkeys, assigning them the roles of sovereign, minister, assistant, and messenger. In the morning, they roamed the Flower-fruit Mountain, and in the evening, they rested in the Waterfall Cave. They shared a harmonious and sincere bond, not joining the flocks of birds, nor following the herds of beasts. They alone ruled as king, and their joy was boundless. Thus: In spring, they gathered various flowers for their meals; in summer, they searched for fruits to sustain their lives. In autumn, they harvested yams and chestnuts to pass the season; in winter, they sought yellow grains to pass the years.

paragraphs.en: 美猴王享樂天真，何期有三五百載。一日，與群猴喜宴之間，忽然憂惱，墮下淚 來。眾猴慌忙羅拜道：「大王何為煩惱？」猴王道：「我雖在歡喜之時，卻有一 點兒遠慮，故此煩惱。」眾猴又笑道：「大王好不知足。我等日日歡會，在仙山 福地，古洞神洲，不伏麒麟轄，不伏鳳凰管，又不伏人間王位所拘束，自由自在 ，乃無量之福，為何遠慮而憂也？」猴王道：「今日雖不歸人王法律，不懼禽獸 威嚴，將來年老血衰，暗中有閻王老子管著，一旦身亡，可不枉生世界之中，不 得久注天人之內？」眾猴聞此言，一個個掩面悲啼，俱以無常為慮。
paragraphs.zh: The Monkey King, enjoying carefree and innocent pleasures, had lived for perhaps three or five hundred years. One day, during a joyous banquet with the monkeys, he suddenly became sad and shed tears. The monkeys, in a panic, gathered around and asked, "Your Majesty, why are you troubled?" The Monkey King said, "Although I am in a happy moment, I have a bit of distant worry, hence my trouble." The monkeys laughed again and said, "Your Majesty, you are truly not content. We daily gather in joy, in the immortal mountains and blessed lands, in ancient caves and divine lands. We are not under the control of the qilin, not under the management of the phoenix, nor bound by the authority of human kings. We are free and easy, which is an immeasurable blessing. Why then do you worry about the future?" The Monkey King said, "Although I am not now under the laws of human kings, nor afraid of the power of beasts and birds, in the future, when I grow old and my blood and energy fade, there is the Lord of the Underworld who will control me. Once I die, will I not have lived in vain in this world, and not be able to remain among the heavenly and human beings for long?" Upon hearing this, the monkeys each covered their faces and wept, all worrying about the impermanence of life.

paragraphs.en: 只見那班部中，忽跳出一個通背猿猴，厲聲高叫道：「大王若是這般遠慮，真所 謂道心開發也。如今五蟲之內，惟有三等名色不伏閻王老子所管。」猴王道： 「你知那三等人？」猿猴道：「乃是佛與仙與神聖三者，躲過輪迴，不生不滅， 與天地山川齊壽。」猴王道：「此三者居於何所？」猿猴道：「他只在閻浮世界 之中，古洞仙山之內。」猴王聞之，滿心歡喜道：「我明日就辭汝等下山，雲遊 海角，遠涉天涯，務必訪此三者，學一個不老長生，常躲過閻君之難。」噫！這 句話，頓教跳出輪迴網，致使齊天大聖成。眾猴鼓掌稱揚，都道：「善哉，善哉 ！我等明日越嶺登山，廣尋些果品，大設筵宴送大王也。」 次日，眾猴果去採仙桃，摘異果，刨山藥，斸黃精。芝蘭香蕙，瑤草奇花， 般般件件，整整齊齊，擺開石凳石桌，排列仙酒仙殽。但見那： 金丸珠彈，紅綻黃肥。金丸珠彈臘櫻桃，色真甘美﹔紅綻黃肥熟梅子，味果香酸 。鮮龍眼，肉甜皮薄﹔火荔枝，核小囊紅。林檎碧實連枝獻，枇杷緗苞帶葉擎。 兔頭梨子雞心棗，消渴除煩更解酲。香桃爛杏，美甘甘似玉液瓊漿﹔脆李楊梅， 酸蔭蔭如脂酥膏酪。紅囊黑子熟西瓜，四瓣黃皮大柿子。石榴裂破，丹砂粒現火 晶珠﹔芋栗剖開，堅硬肉團金瑪瑙。胡桃銀杏可傳茶，椰子葡萄能做酒。榛松榧 柰滿盤盛，橘蔗柑橙盈案擺。熟煨山藥，爛煮黃精。搗碎茯苓並薏苡，石鍋微火 漫炊羹。人間縱有珍饈味，怎比山猴樂更寧。
paragraphs.zh: Just then, from among the group, a long-backed monkey leaped out and shouted loudly: "If the King is thinking this far ahead, it is truly called the awakening of the Dao. Now, among the five categories of creatures, there are only three kinds that are not controlled by the Lord of Hell." The Monkey King asked, "Do you know what the three kinds are?" The monkey replied, "They are the Buddha, the Immortal, and the Holy Sage. They escape the cycle of reincarnation, are neither born nor die, and live as long as heaven and earth and mountains and rivers." The Monkey King asked, "Where do these three reside?" The monkey answered, "They only exist within the world of Jambudvipa, in ancient caves and immortal mountains." Upon hearing this, the Monkey King was overjoyed and said, "I will bid you all farewell tomorrow and go down the mountain, traveling far and wide, seeking these three, and learning an immortal, ageless life, always escaping the calamity of the King of Hell." Alas! These words instantly freed him from the web of reincarnation, leading to the rise of the Great Sage Equal to Heaven. The other monkeys clapped their hands in praise, saying, "Good, good! We will tomorrow cross the mountains and climb the hills, search widely for fruits, and hold a grand feast to send off the King." The next day, the monkeys indeed went to pick immortal peaches, gather rare fruits, dig up ginseng, and dig up polygonum. Orchids and fragrant herbs, jade-like grasses and strange flowers, all kinds of things, neatly arranged, set out stone benches and stone tables, and arranged immortal wine and immortal delicacies. What could be seen was: golden balls and pearl-like bullets, red bursts and yellow plumpness. Golden balls and pearl-like bullets, the wax cherries, with true sweet and delicious flavor; red bursts and yellow plumpness, the ripe plums, with a fragrant and sour taste. Fresh longan, sweet flesh and thin skin; fire-like lychees, small seeds and red sacs. The pears and hawthorns, with green fruits and connected branches, and the loquats, with pink buds and leaves. The rabbit-head pears and the heart-shaped dates, which can quench thirst, remove irritability, and relieve drunkenness. Fragrant peaches and rotten apricots, sweet and smooth like jade liquid and elixir; crisp plums and mulberries, sour and cool like fat and cream. Red-skinned, black-seeded ripe watermelons, four-leaf yellow-skinned large persimmons. Pomegranates split open, revealing red sand-like grains, like glowing pearls; yams and chestnuts split open, showing hard meat balls like golden pearls. Walnuts and ginkgo nuts can be used to pass tea, and coconuts and grapes can be made into wine. Chestnuts, pines, cypresses, and nuts fill the plate, while tangerines, sugarcane, mandarins, and oranges fill the table. Roasted and stewed ginseng, and well-cooked polygonum. Crushed poria and coix seeds, simmered in a stone pot over a low fire, making a soup. Even though the world has delicious foods, how could they compare to the happiness of the mountain monkeys?

paragraphs.en: 群猴尊美猴王上坐，各依齒肩排於下邊，一個個輪流上前奉酒、奉花、奉果，痛 飲了一日。
paragraphs.zh: The group of monkeys revered the Beauty Monkey King to sit in the upper seat, and each one, according to their age, lined up below. One after another, they came forward to present wine, flowers, and fruits, and they drank heartily all day.

paragraphs.en: 次日，美猴王早起，教：「小的們，替我折些枯松，編作?子，取個竹竿作篙， 收拾些果品之類，我將去也。」果獨自登?，儘力撐開，飄飄蕩蕩，徑向大海波 中，趁天風，來渡南贍部洲地界。這一去，正是那： 天產仙猴道行隆，離山駕?趁天風。 飄洋過海尋仙道，立志潛心建大功。 有分有緣休俗願，無憂無慮會元龍。 料應必遇知音者，說破源流萬法通。
paragraphs.zh:
The next day, the Beauty Monkey King rose early and said: "You all, go and pick some withered pines, weave them into a basket, take a bamboo pole as a pole, and gather some fruits and such things. I will go now." He then went alone onto the boat, exerting all his strength to push it open, drifting and swaying, directly heading towards the sea's waves, taking advantage of the heavenly wind to cross over to the land of the Southern Continent. This journey was precisely as the verse says:  

Born of heaven, the monkey sage's path is profound,  
Leaving the mountain, he rides the boat with the heavenly wind.  
Drifting across oceans and seas in search of the immortal path,  
Determined and devoted, he strives to establish great achievements.  
With fate and fortune, he abandons secular wishes,  
Without worries or troubles, he meets the primal dragon.  
He must surely meet a true confidant,  
Who will reveal the origin and bring all laws to clarity.

paragraphs.en: 也是他運至時來，自登木?之後，連日東南風緊，將他送到西北岸前，乃是南贍 部洲地界。持篙試水，偶得淺水，棄了?子，跳上岸來。只見海邊有人捕魚、打 雁、穵蛤、淘鹽。他走近前，弄個把戲，妝個虎，嚇得那些人丟筐棄網，四散奔 跑。將那跑不動的拿住一個，剝了他衣裳，也學人穿在身上。搖搖擺擺，穿州過 府，在市廛中學人禮，學人話。朝餐夜宿，一心裏訪問佛、仙、神聖之道，覓個 長生不老之方。見世人都是為名為利之徒，更無一個為身命者。正是那： 爭名奪利幾時休？早起遲眠不自由！ 騎著驢騾思駿馬，官居宰相望王侯。 只愁衣食耽勞碌，何怕閻君就取勾。 繼子蔭孫圖富貴，更無一個肯回頭。
paragraphs.zh:
It was also due to his good fortune and timely arrival. After boarding the wooden boat, for several days the southeast wind was strong, carrying him to the northwest shore, which was within the territory of the Southern Continent. He used his pole to test the water, and found it shallow. He abandoned the boat, jumped onto the shore. He saw people by the sea fishing, hunting wild geese, digging for clams, and collecting salt. He approached them, performed a trick, pretended to be a tiger, and frightened those people so much that they dropped their baskets and nets and scattered in all directions. He caught one who couldn't run away, stripped him of his clothes, and put them on, imitating human attire. He walked awkwardly, passing through towns and cities, learning human manners and speech in the marketplaces. He ate in the morning and slept at night, constantly seeking the path of the Buddha, immortals, and saints, searching for a way to achieve immortality and eternal life. He saw that all people were driven by fame and profit, and none cared about their own lives. This is exactly what is said:  
When will the struggle for fame and profit ever end?  
Rising early and sleeping late, one is never free!  
Riding a donkey, one still dreams of a fine horse;  
As prime minister, one still yearns for kings and dukes.  
Only worrying about clothing and food, burdened with toil,  
Who fears the Yamen's (Hell's) officials coming to fetch them?  
Striving to secure a legacy for sons and grandsons, pursuing wealth and honor,  
Not one person is willing to turn back.

paragraphs.en: 猴王參訪仙道，無緣得遇。在於南贍部洲，串長城，遊小縣，不覺八九年餘。忽 行至西洋大海，他想著海外必有神仙。獨自個依前作?，又飄過西海，直至西牛 賀洲地界。登岸遍訪多時，忽見一座高山秀麗，林麓幽深。他也不怕狼蟲，不懼 虎豹，登上山頂上觀看。果是好山： 千峰排戟，萬仞開屏。日映嵐光輕鎖翠，雨收黛色冷含青。瘦籐纏老樹，古渡界 幽程。奇花瑞草，修竹喬松。修竹喬松，萬載常青欺福地﹔奇花瑞草，四時不謝 賽蓬瀛。幽鳥啼聲近，源泉響溜清。重重谷壑芝蘭繞，處處巉崖苔蘚生。起伏巒 頭龍脈好，必有高人隱姓名。
paragraphs.zh: The Monkey King visited the immortal path but had no opportunity to meet any immortal. He wandered in the Southern Continent, passing through long walls and traveling in small counties, and without realizing it, eight or nine years had passed. One day, he arrived at the Western Ocean, and he thought that beyond the sea there must be immortals. Alone, he continued forward, drifting across the Western Sea until he reached the land of the Western Ox and Horse. He landed and searched for a long time, when suddenly he saw a beautiful high mountain, with lush forests at its foot, deep and quiet. He was not afraid of wolves or snakes, nor did he fear tigers or leopards, and he climbed to the mountain's peak to look around. Indeed, it was a fine mountain: thousands of peaks stood like swords, and ten thousand cliffs opened like screens. The sun reflected the misty light, gently locking in the greenery, and after the rain, the dark colors gave off a cool, blue hue. Thin vines wrapped old trees, and ancient ferry crossings marked a remote journey. Rare flowers and auspicious grasses, tall bamboos and tall pines. Tall bamboos and tall pines, ever green, surpassing the land of blessings; rare flowers and auspicious grasses, blooming all year round, matching the paradise of Peng and Ying. The call of a quiet bird was near, and the sound of a spring's flowing water was clear. Deep valleys and ravines were surrounded by orchids and orchid-like plants, and every cliff had moss and lichens growing. The undulating hills had a good dragon vein, and there must be a high-ranking person hiding his name.

paragraphs.en: 正觀看間，忽聞得林深之處有人言語。急忙趨步，穿入林中，側耳而聽，原來是 歌唱之聲。歌曰： 「觀棋柯爛，伐木丁丁，雲邊谷口徐行。賣薪沽酒，狂笑自陶情。蒼逕秋高，對 月枕松根，一覺天明。認舊林，登崖過嶺，持斧斷枯籐。收來成一擔，行歌市上 ，易米三升。更無些子爭競，時價平平。不會機謀巧算，沒榮辱，恬淡延生。相 逢處，非仙即道，靜坐講黃庭。」
paragraphs.zh:
While observing, suddenly he heard voices coming from deep within the woods. Hurriedly he stepped forward, entering the forest, and listened attentively. It was the sound of someone singing. The song went:

"Watching the game, the axe rots; chopping wood, the sound of axes echoes. Walking slowly by the mountain's edge and the valley's mouth. Selling firewood, buying wine, laughing wildly, enjoying one's own feelings. The cypress path is high in autumn; lying under the moon, resting by the pine roots, one sleeps until morning comes. Recognizing the old woods, crossing the cliffs and mountains, holding the axe to cut withered vines. Gathering them into a bundle, singing while walking in the market, exchanging for three measures of rice. There is no quarrel or contention, the price is always fair. Not knowing cunning schemes or calculations, without honor or disgrace, living peacefully and calmly. When meeting people, they are either immortals or Taoists, sitting quietly to discuss the Huangting."

paragraphs.en: 美猴王聽得此言，滿心歡喜道：「神仙原來藏在這裏！」即忙跳入裏面，仔細再 看，乃是一個樵子，在那裏舉斧砍柴。但看他打扮非常：
paragraphs.zh: The Monkey King, upon hearing these words, was very happy and said, "So the immortal is hidden here!" He immediately jumped inside and carefully looked around. It was a woodcutter, chopping firewood there. But his appearance was extraordinary:

paragraphs.en: 頭上戴箬笠，乃是新筍初脫之籜。身上穿布衣，乃是木綿撚就之紗。腰間繫環絛 ，乃是老蠶口吐之絲。足下踏草履，乃是枯莎槎就之爽。手執?鋼斧，擔挽火麻 繩。扳松劈枯樹，爭似此樵能。
paragraphs.zh: He wears a bamboo hat, which is the husk of a newly shed bamboo shoot. He is dressed in a cloth robe, which is spun from cotton. A belt is tied around his waist, which is the silk spun by an old silkworm. His feet are clad in straw shoes, which are woven from dried reeds. He holds an iron axe in his hand, and carries a rope made of fire hemp. When he splits pine trees and chops dry wood, who can match this woodcutter's skill?

paragraphs.en: 猴王近前叫道：「老神仙，弟子起手。」那樵漢慌忙丟了斧，轉身答禮道：「不 當人，不當人。我拙漢衣食不全，怎敢當『神仙』二字？」猴王道：「你不是神 仙，如何說出神仙的話來？」樵夫道：「我說甚麼神仙話？」猴王道：「我才來 至林邊，只聽的你說：『相逢處，非仙即道，靜坐講《黃庭》。』《黃庭》乃道 德真言，非神仙而何？」樵夫笑道：「實不瞞你說，這個詞名做《滿庭芳》，乃 一神仙教我的。那神仙與我舍下相鄰，他見我家事勞苦，日常煩惱，教我遇煩惱 時，即把這詞兒念念，一則散心，二則解困。我才有些不足處思慮，故此念念， 不期被你聽了。」猴王道：「你家既與神仙相鄰，何不從他修行？學得個不老之 方，卻不是好？」樵夫道：「我一生命苦：自幼蒙父母養育至八九歲，才知人事 ，不幸父喪，母親居孀。再無兄弟姊妹，只我一人，沒奈何，早晚侍奉。如今母 老，一發不敢拋離。卻又田園荒蕪，衣食不足，只得斫兩束柴薪，挑向市廛之間 ，貨幾文錢，糴幾升米，自炊自造，安排些茶飯，供養老母。所以不能修行。」
paragraphs.zh: The Monkey King approached and said, "O immortal, my disciple greets you." The woodcutter hurriedly dropped his axe and turned to return the greeting, saying, "I am not worthy, I am not worthy. I am just a clumsy farmer, lacking in clothing and food; how can I possibly be called 'immortal'?" The Monkey King said, "If you are not an immortal, how could you speak words of an immortal?" The woodcutter asked, "What words of an immortal did I speak?" The Monkey King replied, "I had just arrived at the edge of the forest, and I heard you say, 'When we meet, one is either a fairy or a Daoist; sit in stillness and recite the 'Huang Ting' [Inner Court].'" The woodcutter laughed and said, "I truly don't hide anything from you. This is called 'Man Ting Fang' [Full Courtyard Fragrance], a song taught to me by a immortal. That immortal lives near my house. Seeing that my family's affairs were hard and my daily life full of troubles, he taught me that whenever I feel troubled, I should recite this song. It would ease my mind and relieve my difficulties. I was just thinking about some minor problems, so I recited it, and I didn't expect you to hear it." The Monkey King said, "Since your house is next to an immortal, why don't you follow him in cultivation and learn to be ageless?" "Is this [the way of the Buddha] not good?" asked the woodcutter. "My life has been full of hardship," he said. "Raised by my parents until I was eight or nine years old, I only began to understand things then. Unfortunately, my father died, and my mother became a widow. I had no brothers or sisters, only myself. With no choice, I had to take care of her morning and night. Now that my mother is old, I dare not leave her. But my fields have become neglected, and my food and clothing are insufficient. So I cut two bundles of firewood, carried them to the market, sold a few coins, bought a few sheng of rice, cooked my own food, and prepared some tea and meals to support my old mother. That is why I cannot cultivate the Way."

paragraphs.en: 猴王道：「據你說起來，乃是一個行孝的君子，向後必有好處。但望你指與我那 神仙住處，卻好拜訪去也。」樵夫道：「不遠，不遠。此山叫做靈臺方寸山，山 中有座斜月三星洞，那洞中有一個神仙，稱名須菩提祖師。那祖師出去的徒弟， 也不計其數，見今還有三四十人從他修行。你順那條小路兒，向南行七八里遠近 ，即是他家了。」猴王用手扯住樵夫道：「老兄，你便同我去去，若還得了好處 ，決不忘你指引之恩。」樵夫道：「你這漢子甚不通變，我方才這般與你說了， 你還不省？假若我與你去了，卻不誤了我的生意？老母何人奉養？我要斫柴，你 自去，自去。」
paragraphs.zh: The Monkey King said, "According to what you say, you are a virtuous gentleman who respects filial piety, and you will surely have good fortune in the future. But I beg you to show me where the immortal resides, so I may go pay him a visit." The woodcutter said, "Not far, not far. This mountain is called Lingtai Fangcun Mountain. In the mountain there is a pavilion called Xieyue Sanxing Cave. There is an immortal living in that cave, named Subodhi, the Patriarch. The number of disciples the Patriarch has sent out is countless, and now there are still thirty or forty people who are still studying under him. If you follow that small path and go south for about seven or eight li, that is his home." The Monkey King grabbed the woodcutter's arm and said, "Old brother, you should come with me. If I gain any benefits, I will never forget your guidance." The woodcutter said, "You are such a foolish fellow. I just told you like this, and you still don't understand? If I went with you, wouldn't that interfere with my business? Who would take care of my mother? I need to cut firewood. You go by yourself, go by yourself."

paragraphs.en: 猴王聽說，只得相辭。出深林，找上路徑，過一山坡，約有七八里遠，果然望見 一座洞府。挺身觀看，真好去處！但見： 煙霞散彩，日月搖光。千株老柏，萬節修篁。千株老柏，帶雨半空青冉冉﹔萬節 修篁，含煙一壑色蒼蒼。門外奇花佈錦，橋邊瑤草噴香。石崖突兀青苔潤，懸壁 高張翠蘚長。時聞仙鶴唳，每見鳳凰翔。仙鶴唳時，聲振九皋霄漢遠﹔鳳凰翔起 ，翎毛五色彩雲光。玄猿白鹿隨隱見，金獅玉象任行藏。細觀靈福地，真個賽天 堂。
paragraphs.zh: The Monkey King, upon hearing this, had no choice but to take his leave. He exited the deep forest, found the path, crossed a hill, and about seven or eight li away, he indeed saw a cave palace. He stood up to take a look, and it was truly a wonderful place! It was as described: mist and clouds scattered color, the sun and moon shook with light. Thousands of old cypresses, ten thousand bamboo groves. Thousands of old cypresses, with rain, their greenery floated in the sky; ten thousand bamboo groves, with mist, their color was dark green in the valley. Outside the gate, rare flowers spread like brocade; by the bridge, fragrant grasses exuded scent. The stone cliffs were towering, with green moss moistened; the high cliffs had long green mosses hanging down. Occasionally, the sound of a crane's call was heard, and often, a phoenix was seen flying. When the crane called, its voice echoed far into the sky; when the phoenix flew, its feathers displayed five colors, shining with clouds of light. Black apes and white deer appeared and disappeared at will; golden lions and jade elephants moved freely. Upon careful observation, this sacred land was truly better than heaven.

paragraphs.en: 又見那洞門緊閉，靜悄悄杳無人跡。忽回頭，見崖頭立一石碑，約有三丈餘高， 八尺餘闊，上有一行十個大字，乃是「靈臺方寸山，斜月三星洞」。美猴王十分 歡喜道：「此間人果是樸實，果有此山此洞。」看勾多時，不敢敲門。且去跳上 松枝梢頭，摘松子吃了頑耍。
paragraphs.zh: Again, he saw the cave's gate tightly closed, silent and empty, with no one in sight. Suddenly turning back, he saw a stone tablet standing on the cliff, about thirty feet high and eight feet wide, with ten large characters on it: "Lingtai Fangcun Mountain, Xieyue Sanxing Cave." The Monkey King was very happy and said, "People here are indeed simple and honest, indeed there is this mountain and this cave." After looking at it for a while, he did not dare to knock on the door. Instead, he jumped onto the top of a pine tree, plucked pine nuts, and played around eating them.

paragraphs.en: 少頃間，只聽得呀的一聲，洞門開處，裏面走出一個仙童，真個丰姿英偉，像貌 清奇，比尋常俗子不同。但見他： 髽髻雙絲綰，寬袍兩袖風。 貌和身自別，心與相俱空。 物外長年客，山中永壽童。 一塵全不染，甲子任翻騰。
paragraphs.zh: A short while later, there was a sound of "ah," and the cave door opened. A fairy child came out from inside. His appearance was noble and heroic, his looks clear and extraordinary, different from ordinary people. Seeing him: His hair was tied in two braids, his wide robe fluttered with the wind. His appearance and body were distinct, his mind and appearance both empty. A guest of eternal years beyond the world, a child of endless life in the mountains. He was completely unstained by the slightest dust, and the years turned as he pleased.

paragraphs.en: 那童子出得門來，高叫道：「甚麼人在此搔擾？」猴王撲的跳下樹來，上前躬身 道：「仙童，我是個訪道學仙之弟子，更不敢在此搔擾。」仙童笑道：「你是個 訪道的麼？」猴王道：「是。」童子道：「我家師父正才下榻，登壇講道，還未 說出原由，就教我出來開門。說：『外面有個修行的來了，可去接待接待。』想 必就是你了？」猴王笑道：「是我，是我。」童子道：「你跟我進來。」
paragraphs.zh: The young boy came out of the gate and shouted, "Who is disturbing here?" The Monkey King jumped down from the tree and approached, bowing respectfully and saying, "Young immortal, I am a disciple seeking the Way and learning immortality, and I would never dare to disturb here." The young immortal laughed and said, "Are you a seeker of the Way?" The Monkey King said, "Yes." The boy said, "My master has just gotten out of bed and is now on the altar giving a lecture. Before he could explain the reason, he sent me out to open the gate, saying, 'There is a practitioner coming from outside, go and receive him.' I suppose that must be you?" The Monkey King laughed and said, "It's me, it's me." The boy said, "Follow me inside."

paragraphs.en: 這猴王整衣端肅，隨童子徑入洞天深處觀看：一層層深閣瓊樓，一進進珠宮貝闕 ，說不盡那靜室幽居。直至瑤臺之下，見那菩提祖師端坐在臺上，兩邊有三十個 小仙侍立臺下。果然是： 大覺金仙沒垢姿，西方妙相祖菩提。不生不滅三三行，全氣全神萬萬慈。空寂自 然隨變化，真如本性任為之。與天同壽莊嚴體，歷劫明心大法師。
paragraphs.zh:
This monkey king straightened his robe and solemnly followed the child into the depths of the cave paradise. There were layer upon layer of pavilions of jade and palace halls of pearl and shell, countless and indescribable in their quiet and secluded dwellings. Until reaching the jade terrace, he saw the Patriarch Bodhi seated on the terrace, with thirty little immortals standing by the terrace below. Indeed, it was as described:

A golden awakened immortal, pure and spotless in form, the Buddha of the Western Pure Land, the Patriarch Bodhi. Neither born nor dying, he follows the threefold path, full of energy and spirit, infinitely compassionate. He is naturally empty and ever-changing, his true nature free to act. His body, as ageless as heaven, is dignified and noble; he is a great teacher of the Dharma, enlightened through countless eons.

paragraphs.en: 美猴王一見，倒身下拜，磕頭不計其數，口中只道：「師父，師父，我弟子志心 朝禮，志心朝禮。」祖師道：「你是那方人氏？且說個鄉貫、姓名明白，再拜。」 猴王道：「弟子乃東勝神洲傲來國花果山水簾洞人氏。」祖師喝令：「趕出去！ 他本是個撒詐搗虛之徒，那裏修甚麼道果！」猴王慌忙磕頭不住道：「弟子是老 實之言，決無虛詐。」祖師道：「你既老實，怎麼說東勝神洲？那去處到我這裏 隔兩重大海，一座南贍部洲，如何就得到此？」猴王叩頭道：「弟子飄洋過海， 登界遊方，有十數個年頭，方才訪到此處。」
paragraphs.zh: When the Monkey King saw him, he immediately fell to his knees, bowing repeatedly, his head hitting the ground countless times, and said with his mouth: "Master, master, my disciple sincerely pays homage, sincerely pays homage." The Master said, "Where are you from? Tell me clearly your native place and name before I accept your bowing." The Monkey King said, "My disciple is from the Flower-Fruit Mountain Waterfall Cave in the Aolai Kingdom of the East-Sheng Divine Continent." The Master ordered, "Drive him out! He is merely a trickster, how could he possibly cultivate any Dao fruit!" The Monkey King hurriedly kept bowing and said, "My disciple speaks the truth, there is no deception at all." The Master said, "If you are honest, why do you say East-Sheng Divine Continent? That place is separated from here by two great seas, and there is also the Southern Continent of the Jambudvipa, how could you have possibly arrived here?" The Monkey King bowed and said, "My disciple drifted across the ocean, traveled through the world for several years before finally finding this place."

paragraphs.en: 祖師道：「既是逐漸行來的也罷。你姓甚麼？」猴王又道：「我無性。人若罵我 ，我也不惱﹔若打我，我也不嗔。只是陪個禮兒就罷了。一生無性。」祖師道： 「不是這個性。你父母原來姓甚麼？」猴王道：「我也無父母。」祖師道：「既 無父母，想是樹上生的？」猴王道：「我雖不是樹上生，卻是石裏長的。我只記 得花果山上有一塊仙石，其年石破，我便生也。」祖師聞言暗喜，道：「這等說 ，卻是個天地生成的。你起來走走我看。」猴王縱身跳起，拐呀拐的走了兩遍。 祖師笑道：「你身軀雖是鄙陋，卻像個食松果的猢猻。我與你就身上取個姓氏， 意思教你姓『猢』。猢字去了個獸傍，乃是個古月。古者，老也﹔月者，陰也。 老陰不能化育，教你姓『猻』倒好。猻字去了獸傍，乃是個子系。子者，兒男也﹔ 系者。嬰細也，正合嬰兒之本論。教你姓『孫』罷。」猴王聽說，滿心歡喜，朝 上叩頭道：「好！好！好！今日方知姓也。萬望師父慈悲，既然有姓，再乞賜個 名字，卻好呼喚。」祖師道：「我門中有十二個字，分派起名，到你乃第十輩之 小徒矣。」猴王道：「那十二個字？」祖師道：「乃廣、大、智、慧、真、如、 性、海、穎、悟、圓、覺十二字。排到你，正當『悟』字。與你起個法名叫做 『孫悟空』，好麼？」猴王笑道：「好！好！好！自今就叫做孫悟空也。」正是： 鴻濛初闢原無姓，打破頑空須悟空。 畢竟不知向後修些甚麼道果，且聽下回分解。
paragraphs.zh: The Master said, "Since you have gradually come here, what is your surname?" The Monkey King said again, "I have no nature. If someone scolds me, I won't be angry; if someone beats me, I won't get angry. I'll just apologize. I have no nature throughout my life." The Master said, "That is not the nature I mean. What was your father's surname?" The Monkey King said, "I have no father or mother." The Master said, "If you have no parents, perhaps you were born from a tree?" The Monkey King said, "Although I was not born from a tree, I was born from a stone. I only remember that on the Flower-Fruit Mountain there was a divine stone. In the year the stone cracked, I was born." Upon hearing this, the Master was secretly pleased and said, "In that case, you are indeed born from heaven and earth. Get up and walk a bit for me." The Monkey King leaped up and walked twice with a limp. The Master laughed and said, "Although your body is rather ugly, you look like a monkey that eats pine cones. I will give you a surname from your body, meaning you shall be surnamed 'Hu.' The character 'Hu' loses its 'animal' radical, and becomes 'Gu Yue.' 'Gu' means old, and 'Yue' means yin." If Lao Yin cannot give birth to offspring, it would be better for you to take the surname "Sun." The character "Sun" without the "animal" radical becomes the character "Xi," which means "child" and "infant." This perfectly matches the original concept of an infant. Let you take the surname "Sun." The Monkey King heard this, was very happy, and bowed to the master above, saying, "Good! Good! Good! Today I finally know my surname. I beg my master, out of compassion, since I now have a surname, please also bestow upon me a name, so that I may be called by it." The master said, "Our school has twelve characters, which are used to name the disciples. You are the youngest disciple of the tenth generation." The Monkey King asked, "What are the twelve characters?" The master said, "They are: Guang, Da, Zhi, Hui, Zhen, Ru, Xing, Hai, Ying, Wu, Yuan, Jue. When it comes to you, it is the character Wu. I will give you the dharma name 'Sun Wukong.' Is that okay?" The Monkey King laughed, "Good! Good! Good! From now on, I shall be called Sun Wukong." It is said: Originally, when the universe was in chaos, there was no surname; to break through the dullness of ignorance, one must attain Wukong. We do not yet know what kind of path he will cultivate or what fruit he will attain; let us see what happens in the next chapter.
